The newest `dev` build (1898ba2) breaks the page limit. A paragraph of the discussion, "Practice and impact", now sits on page 10, above the References heading. The venue allows 9 pages of main text, so about 12 lines have to go. In the 1457fbf build the References heading was still on page 9, so the overflow came from the text added since.

I opened `paper-repo`#9 with this. It says to cut prose first, then move Fig. 2 to the appendix, then drop Table 1 and the compact search table, in that order. It also asks to re-check the page count after the font fix, because that fix changes the layout.

The Type 3 font problem (`paper-repo`#5) is still there on pages 1, 11, 23, 24 and 26. The `\usepackage{courier}` fix I tested hasn't been applied.

Outline revision 15 and Brief revision 7 changed no venue requirement. I pushed nothing in my own repository.
